objective: Complete readable high-level C reimplementation of the firmware, thoroughly compared against original input and output
implementation_constraint: All subsystems must be high-level C; generated instruction translation or runtime ROM execution is not an acceptable final implementation

requirements.scope: Full startup, persistent state, power management, peripheral interactions and emulator callbacks
requirements.implemented_subset: Prepared boot and emulator host bridge, typed persistent variable/result/display state, replay append/eviction/recall and diagnostic contrast UI; main routing/key-wait scheduler and typed UI/menu/screen completion are available; full subordinate lifecycle integration is pending; a portable runtime scheduler now composes boot, main, INPUT and supported menu controllers while exposing pending typed body requests; an opaque persistent device API now retains a full data/MMIO image through raw-key steps, exposes read-only snapshots and explicit timer/callback controls, and composes admitted parameter-menu children. Original raw-key and prepared parameter-menu tests have separate frozen evidence; missing child services remain incomplete. The default diagnostic lifecycle now computes its Read caption by executing the C ROM/status/retention routine against a volatile software resource backend, with the original display ordering retained. Physical CPU certification and host interrupt timing are separate limits. The default retained runtime now owns the real DISTRIBUTION parameter child and preserves its context through menu waits, back navigation, export, timer and reset; prepared raw-key return-to-MAIN has a separate original-ROM proof.

requirements.scope: Keyboard scanning, editing, cursor, menus, history and mode setup
requirements.implemented_subset: Prepared key controllers, editors/cursors, input export/equation normalization, error dialog/key acceptance and editable/cached-result cursor restoration; ordinary input evaluation/variable/Ans/replay commit, cancellation/error/reset/export continuation and linear/natural expression/result presentation. Ordinary outer typing/command dispatch is available; generic menu navigation, MODE/SETUP and MATRIX/VECTOR mode menu controllers are available; their complete scheduler composition and specialized contexts remain pending Prepared SOLVE coefficient and guess entry, equation restoration and result/error lifecycle are available; complete outer scheduler composition remains pending. Prepared matrix/vector bank selection, scalar cell commits and whole INPUT presentation are available; prepared linear EQN coefficient commit, solve, root replay and coefficient-screen return are implemented. DISTRIBUTION parameter navigation, kind/flag selection, row insertion, mode12 table clearing and actual child return are implemented in a retained controller; following calculation screens remain partial.

requirements.scope: All input token categories, literal bases, precedence, function dispatch, variables, errors and mode constraints
requirements.implemented_subset: Shared supported COMP/CMPLX and BASE-N grammar, scalar variables and stores, random/RanInt with eager live seed effects and numerical calculus preflight. Supported physical rich arithmetic, unary operations and REF/RREF compose with storage staging and terminal cleanup, with a separate original-ROM whole-parser corpus. Stored Y-mean raw8A reads the physical statistics table. Complete rich expression and mode grammar remain pending. Explicit live physical and named-source transports support real integral callbacks; a dedicated TABLE continuation API preserves actual mode88. Physical stored-SURD Pol/Rec, argument, magnitude, rooted-coordinate and live input/pool aliases now have whole-parser proofs; bounded paired C4 derivative glue has a 330-recipe whole-parser O2/O3 proof including aliases, errors, cancellation and independent ordinary-output compatibility.

requirements.scope: Exact numeric storage, decimal arithmetic, rational and surd arithmetic, rounding, range and error semantics
Trigonometry, inverse functions, exponentials, logarithms, roots, powers and angle-unit conversions
requirements.implemented_subset: Square/cube/nth roots, forward/inverse trigonometry and special-result tables, all six hyperbolic functions, ln/log10/arbitrary-base logarithms, exp/exp10, general real powers and prepared complex coordinates; complete mode UI remains pending

requirements.scope: Numerical integration/differentiation/sums, solving, combinatorics, random functions and complex arithmetic
requirements.implemented_subset: Factorial/permutations/combinations/percent, shared COMP/CMPLX expressions, scalar absolute/conjugation/argument, finite sum/product, adaptive Gauss-Kronrod integral and Richardson derivative expression orchestration with native sample order, cancellation and X restoration. Prepared linear/quadratic/cubic solvers and native degeneracy diagnostics are available; prepared generic SOLVE numerical callback iteration is available; Prepared SOLVE equation grammar exports raw sides and PreAns to a readable callback bridge; coefficient/guess prompts, typed coefficient acceptance, default memory-backed numerical solve, variable/result/history commits and error recovery have separate and uninterrupted workflow controls. Prepared CALC/SOLVE outer scalar workflow and random/RanInt expression integration are available. Full reset/key/menu composition, remaining physical calculus modes, C4 derivative/series and native corrupted-frame continuations remain pending; the physical real Richardson derivative now stages arguments and reloads RAM-backed working records after callbacks/polls Addressed C4 integral preparation, ordered paired transfers, sampled X, equal-bound/error/cancellation outcomes and workspace prefix through04696 are implemented. Paired C4 derivative preparation/core and expression glue preserve live X pairs and first-versus-later evaluator error policies; finite series and uncovered physical continuations remain partial.

requirements.scope: Statistics, distributions, equation, matrix, vector, table and base-N modes, constants and unit conversions
requirements.implemented_subset: Prepared statistics/regression kernels and table editor/cache/normal distribution kernels; matrix/vector arithmetic, determinant/inverse, REF/RREF, numeric preparation, typed slot storage, prepared rich operand dispatch/allocation and grid/caption/cursor display; equation/inequality result display; BASE-N word conversion, arithmetic/logic, radix literals, stored-scalar preparation and integer formatting; DMS/constant/conversion expression dispatch and BASE-N shared grammar; prepared generic menus, MODE/SETUP and MATRIX/VECTOR dimension/action menu controllers; linear/quadratic/cubic equation kernels and native failure diagnostics. Complete mode grammar/UI and object allocation/editing, equation coefficient/history/display orchestration, complete TABLE expression/UI composition and complete menu/scheduler composition remain pending Prepared TABLE one/two-function generation preserves live row records, range limits, callback errors and cancellation. Prepared BASE word APIs preserve independent selected/global/operation policies. Dedicated TABLE continuation, parameter, range/prompt and presentation bodies are available; prepared linear2/3 equation and bounded matrix/vector bank workflows retain independent state through their event sequences. Complete whole-main mode integration remains pending. Whole TABLE UI and explicit MAIN bodies are now available for bounded workflows. Linear EQN uses one observed solve with live timer publication; four complete runtime workflows and 54 retained failure prefixes are verified, while error UI/default body ownership remain pending. The DISTRIBUTION parameter child is installed in the default runtime; selection, row/table editing and raw host continuations are covered separately from distribution numerical kernels and their following screen bodies.

requirements.scope: All decimal, rational, surd, pi, recurring, sexagesimal, complex and mode-specific output policies
Fonts, pixels, recursive expression layout, editing decorations, clipping and display transfers
Runnable calculator with original expression and key-sequence input/output behavior
requirements.implemented_subset: Supported COMP arithmetic, fractions, square/cube/nth roots, powers, factorial/percent/nPr/nCr, forward/inverse trig and hyperbolic, single/two-argument logarithms and exponentials through records, formatter tokens, layout and LCD; structured display-to-input conversion and error cursor mapping. Prepared editor, cursor and nonblocking host key-wait/controller and annunciator APIs; complete key UI and other mode pipelines remain pending; shared CMPLX expression evaluation and prepared rectangular output composed through natural display tokens and LCD pixels; prepared scalar variable transactions and finite sum/product, integral and derivative expressions now share the evaluator grammar. Prepared input recovery and nonblocking diagnostic lifecycle are available; ordinary input transaction and presentation controllers are available; ordinary outer typing/command dispatch and main scheduling are available; subordinate menus and specialized calculator lifecycle integration remain pending; prepared BASE-N grammar now composes integer formatter tokens and LCD pixels, and DMS/constants/unit conversions share the evaluator. Generic menus and mode/setup/bank controllers are implemented independently, with complete outer scheduler composition still pending Paired Pol/Rec, AF polar and quotient/remainder expressions compose native status/labels, retained records and result pixels; prepared physical temporary-bank prestaging and terminal cleanup preserve tested variable/workspace aliases. The SOLVE prompt-to-default numerical result-commit flow is verified separately from full outer key scanning and scheduler composition. A browser device preview now exposes the real persistent C device and LCD through explicit raw-key steps, timer acknowledgments and callback controls; full ordinary key scheduling and unsupported advanced controllers remain incomplete.

requirements.scope: Differential tests for full public behavior, boundary/error cases and interactions, beyond isolated routine fixtures

completion_gate: All requirements completed and directly verified against original behavior. Passing tests for implemented subsets never implies full completion.
understanding_metric: Unique documented understood instruction addresses / 46094 decoded instructions in the pinned complete.asm listing; conservative lower bound, separate from completion and parity. See the tracked understood_ranges.json ledgers; the pinned listing and supporting semantic models are local prerequisites.
